issues.description: Default speaker for bulbul:v3-beta disagrees between code (shubh) and docs (aditya).
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh' for bulbul:v3-beta, but module docstring, class docstring, and PR description all promise 'aditya'. This is a contract violation between specification and implementation. Pick one and make code and docs agree before merge.

issues.description: Unsupported-parameter warnings compare against defaults, conflating intent with default value.
issues.detail: Checks like `params.temperature != 0.6`, `params.pitch != 0.0`, `params.loudness != 1.0` cannot distinguish unset from set-to-default. Callers who explicitly set the default get no warning; callers who want the default look identical to omitters. Use a None sentinel or explicit-set detection.

issues.description: STT and TTS apply opposite enforcement policies for unsupported parameters.
issues.detail: SarvamSTTService raises ValueError on unsupported params; SarvamHttpTTSService merely logs a warning and silently drops them. Two services in the same package should not present opposite contracts. Also, speaker enums and per-model speaker tuples exist but voice_id is never validated against the selected model. Pick one discipline and apply it uniformly.

issues.description: Pace silently clamped to narrower v3-beta range, violating InputParams field contract.
issues.detail: InputParams declares pace with Field(ge=0.3, le=3.0), but v3-beta narrows accepted range to 0.5-2.0 and silently clamps. The subtype strengthens the precondition without surfacing it to callers. Either raise ValueError or split InputParams per model so the type reflects the real contract.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently falls back to v2 speakers for unknown models.
issues.detail: The helper returns v2 speakers for any unrecognized model string, leaking ambiguity: callers cannot tell 'unknown model' from 'v2 model' by the return value. Prefer raising ValueError to match __init__ behavior, or return an empty list. Silent fallback is a special case the rest of the code does not need.

issues.description: SarvamTTSModel enum is decorative; dispatch still keys on raw string literals.
issues.detail: The PR introduces SarvamTTSModel for type safety, then keys TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS and all comparisons by raw strings like 'bulbul:v2'. The enum becomes a label rather than a typed boundary. Either key configs by the enum and accept enum-or-str in __init__, or drop the enum entirely.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the refactor to ModelConfig/TTSModelConfig tables is the right architectural direction — replacing fragile substring checks like `"saaras" in model.lower()` with data-driven dispatch is good taste. Both reviewers converge on a documented default speaker that disagrees with code (aditya vs shubh), warning logic that compares against defaults instead of detecting explicit user input, and inconsistent enforcement discipline between STT (raises) and TTS (warns and drops silently). Liskov additionally flags pace clamping that violates the declared InputParams range and an enum that exists only as a label. Land after fixing the speaker default, warning logic, and enforcement consistency; the direction is right.
